gloss: one by one; in detail; point by point

definitions.gloss: one by one; item by item; in detail
definitions.explanation: Addressing or examining each item individually without omitting any. Often used for reports or explanations.

examples.japanese: {経過|けいか}を{逐一|ちくいち}{報告|ほうこく}する。
{問題点|もんだいてん}を{逐一|ちくいち}{検討|けんとう}した。
examples.english: We examined the problems one by one.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{行動|こうどう}を{逐一|ちくいち}{監視|かんし}されている。
examples.english: His every move is being monitored.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{逐|ちく} (pursue, one by one) + {一|いち} (one)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {逐一|ちくいち}{報告|ほうこく}する - to report in detail
- {逐一|ちくいち}{説明|せつめい}する - to explain point by point
- {逐一|ちくいち}{検討|けんとう}する - to examine one by one
- {逐一|ちくいち}{記録|きろく}する - to record every detail

REGISTER:
Formal. Commonly used in business, academic, and official contexts.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {逐次|ちくじ} - sequentially, successively (emphasizes order)
- {一々|いちいち} - one by one (more colloquial, can be critical)
- {詳細|しょうさい}に - in detail
